import sys, json, time, hashlib, os
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import jax
jax.config.update("jax_enable_x64", True)
import vmex as vj
import vmecpp
from importlib.metadata import version
repo=Path(sys.argv[1]); dest=Path(sys.argv[2]); rows=[]
for name in ["input.shaped_tokamak_pressure_polished", "input.nfp2_QA_smooth_beta"]:
    path=repo/"examples/data"/name
    inp=vj.VmecInput.from_file(path)
    vpp=vmecpp.VmecInput.from_file(path)
    t=time.perf_counter(); cpp=vmecpp.run(vpp, max_threads=1, verbose=False); cpp_seconds=time.perf_counter()-t
    t=time.perf_counter(); result=vj.solve_multigrid(inp, verbose=False, polish_force_balance=False); jax.block_until_ready(result.state); first=time.perf_counter()-t
    t=time.perf_counter(); again=vj.solve_multigrid(inp, verbose=False, polish_force_balance=False); jax.block_until_ready(again.state); warm=time.perf_counter()-t
    w=vj.wout_from_state(inp=inp,state=result.state,fsqr=result.fsqr,fsqz=result.fsqz,fsql=result.fsql,niter=result.iterations,converged=result.converged)
    vj.write_wout(dest/(name+".vmex.nc"),w); cpp.wout.save(dest/(name+".vmecpp.nc"))
    diffs={}
    for key in ["rmnc","zmns","lmns","iotaf","presf"]:
        a=np.asarray(getattr(w,key)); b=np.asarray(getattr(cpp.wout,key))
        if a.shape!=b.shape and a.shape==b.T.shape:b=b.T
        diffs[key]={"vmex_shape":list(a.shape),"vmecpp_shape":list(b.shape),"relative_l2":float(np.linalg.norm(a-b)/max(np.linalg.norm(b),1e-30)),"max_abs":float(np.max(np.abs(a-b)))}
    row=dict(input=name,sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),vmex_converged=bool(result.converged),vmex_iterations=int(result.iterations),vmex_fsq=[float(result.fsqr),float(result.fsqz),float(result.fsql)],vmecpp_ier_flag=int(cpp.wout.ier_flag),vmecpp_iterations=int(cpp.wout.niter),vmecpp_fsq=[float(cpp.wout.fsqr),float(cpp.wout.fsqz),float(cpp.wout.fsql)],seconds=dict(vmex_first=first,vmex_warm=warm,vmecpp=cpp_seconds),coefficient_differences=diffs)
    rows.append(row);print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
    (dest/"same-deck-comparison.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(jax=jax.__version__,vmecpp=version("vmecpp"),vmex_path=vj.__file__,vmecpp_path=vmecpp.__file__,jit_disabled=bool(jax.config.jax_disable_jit),rows=rows,scope="Two same-input smoke comparisons, cold and one warm VMEX sample; shared host under unrelated load, no speedup or continuous-force ranking."),indent=2))

import importlib.util, sys, json, time
from pathlib import Path
import jax
jax.config.update('jax_enable_x64',True)
import jax.numpy as jnp
import numpy as np
from scipy.sparse.linalg import cg, lsmr, LinearOperator
from vmex.core.polish import make_strong_structured_chart, strong_collocation_residual
from vmex.core.polish_driver import _collocation_variable_scale
repo=Path(sys.argv[1]); out=Path(sys.argv[2]); started=time.perf_counter()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('polish_tests',repo/'tests/test_polish_preconditioner.py'); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
rt=m.small_strong_root.__wrapped__(m.small_adapter.__wrapped__())
chart=make_strong_structured_chart(rt,balance_iterations=1,balance_probes=2)
x=jnp.zeros(chart.size); r0=strong_collocation_residual(x,rt,chart); a=jnp.sqrt(jnp.mean(r0*r0)); D=_collocation_variable_scale(rt,chart,a,x,int(r0.size),2)
r=lambda y: strong_collocation_residual(D*y,rt,chart)/a
f=lambda y: .5*jnp.vdot(r(y),r(y))
rr=np.asarray(r(x)); J=np.asarray(jax.jit(jax.jacfwd(r))(x)); H=np.asarray(jax.jit(jax.hessian(f))(x)); g=J.T@rr
s=np.linalg.svd(J,compute_uv=False); eig=np.linalg.eigvalsh((H+H.T)/2)
v=np.random.default_rng(4).normal(size=x.size);v/=np.linalg.norm(v)
fd=[]
grad=jax.jit(jax.grad(f)); hv=H@v
for h in [1e-3,1e-4,1e-5]:
 z=(np.asarray(grad(x+h*v))-np.asarray(grad(x-h*v)))/(2*h)
 fd.append(dict(h=h,relative_error=float(np.linalg.norm(z-hv)/np.linalg.norm(hv))))
rows=[]
for mu in [1e-3,1e-6]:
 A=J.T@J+mu*np.eye(x.size);b=-g
 ref=np.linalg.lstsq(np.vstack([J,np.sqrt(mu)*np.eye(x.size)]),np.r_[-rr,np.zeros(x.size)],rcond=None)[0]
 for label,M in [('cg',None),('diagonal-cg',LinearOperator(A.shape,matvec=lambda z:z/np.diag(A)))]:
  count=[0]
  def callback(z):count[0]+=1
  z,status=cg(A,b,rtol=1e-8,atol=0,maxiter=10*x.size,M=M,callback=callback)
  rows.append(dict(method=label,damping=mu,iterations=count[0],status=int(status),relative_true_normal_residual=float(np.linalg.norm(A@z-b)/np.linalg.norm(b)),relative_step_error=float(np.linalg.norm(z-ref)/np.linalg.norm(ref))))
 z=lsmr(J,-rr,damp=np.sqrt(mu),atol=1e-12,btol=1e-12,conlim=1e12,maxiter=10*x.size)
 rows.append(dict(method='lsmr',damping=mu,iterations=int(z[2]),status=int(z[1]),relative_true_normal_residual=float(np.linalg.norm(A@z[0]-b)/np.linalg.norm(b)),relative_step_error=float(np.linalg.norm(z[0]-ref)/np.linalg.norm(ref))))
report=dict(shape=list(J.shape),residual_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(rr)),gradient_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(g)),jacobian_condition=float(s[0]/s[-1]),singular_values=s.tolist(),hessian_eigenvalues=eig.tolist(),hessian_asymmetry=float(np.linalg.norm(H-H.T)/np.linalg.norm(H)),relative_residual_curvature=float(np.linalg.norm(H-J.T@J)/np.linalg.norm(H)),hvp_fd=fd,linear_solves=rows,elapsed_seconds=time.perf_counter()-started,scope='Frozen current collocation functional at initial tiny Solovev lift; no nonlinear convergence, Cartesian metric, 3-D speedup, or solver promotion established.')
out.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print(json.dumps(report),flush=True)
